detail.title: Operational Foundations of Causal Memory
detail.summary: This research cycle advances the operational framework for causal memory, distinguishing persistent physical states from functional memory states through the lens of predictive sufficiency. We focus on systematizing the criteria for causal states to bridge the gap between computational mechanics and thermodynamic dissipation, establishing the groundwork for future validation of these memory models.
